import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
def task_func(
    feature_array,
    target_array,
    feature_names=["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5"],
    target_name="target",
    seed=None,
):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    shuffled_indices = rng.permutation(feature_array.shape[1])
    shuffled_array = feature_array[:, shuffled_indices]
    df = pd.DataFrame(shuffled_array, columns=feature_names)
    df[target_name] = target_array
    clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=seed)
    clf.fit(df[feature_names], df[target_name])
    return clf

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
def task_func(
    feature_array,
    target_array,
    feature_names=["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5"],
    target_name="target",
    seed=None,
):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    shuffled_indices = rng.permutation(feature_array.shape[1])
    shuffled_array = feature_array[:, shuffled_indices]
    df = pd.DataFrame(shuffled_array, columns=feature_names)
    df[target_name] = target_array
    clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=seed)
    clf.fit(df[feature_names], df[target_name])
    return clf
